review_Base_class: review the Base class which is a PyTorch nn.Module base for generator models with seed management
build_Base_subclass: build a subclass of Base that implements generate_iter and loss methods for a custom generator
test_Base_seed: test the Base class seed setter to verify it creates a torch.Generator with manual seed
test_Base_random_generator: test the Base class random_generator property to verify it returns the internal torch.Generator
run_Base_forward: run the Base forward method which delegates to generate and returns the final generated tensor
